label: main season
summary: Recommend returning SFR-0118 for further non-technical survey. The sole informative source reports only four years of safe use along streams, below the cancellation threshold of two reliable first-hand sources each reporting at least five years. The survey team could not see the interior, and the other informant does not know it; there is no target for technical survey or clearance.
flags: The survey visit was limited to the area edge because rain closed the trail; further NTS should seek adequate information about the interior and additional reliable first-hand accounts of land use and safety.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: he has hunted and fished along the streams in the area every year for the past 4 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E1.note: The informant personally uses part of the area and reports repeated safe use, supporting absence; this is one first-hand source and covers four years.

E2.quote: could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E2.note: This records the limits of the visit, not whether EO is present or absent in the unseen area.

E3.quote: he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E3.note: The driver expressly lacks knowledge of the land inside, so this provides no evidence of presence or absence.
